plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Exit all 2x AI/Software (METU, MSFU, PLTU) and 2x Semiconductor (MUU) positions.

conservative.read: This plan focuses on capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names, aiming for low drawdowns. Expect a large cash position.

plan: Reduce exposure in most leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, MUU).
Add a new, high-scoring long setup (NVDD) for potential growth.
This balances risk reduction with targeted growth opportunities.
It aims for a moderate monthly return of about 2.5%.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets about 2.5% monthly return by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a promising new name. It aims for risk-first growth, keeping drawdowns in check with a moderate cash buffer. Leverage is kept low.

plan: Increase exposure in leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, MUU).
Add a new, high-scoring long setup (NVDD) with significant allocation.

It targets around 4% monthly return but with higher potential drawdowns.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for high growth (target ~4%/mo) by increasing leveraged ETF exposure and concentrating in strong scanner setups. It accepts significantly higher potential drawdowns and the risks of leveraged ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names.
Significantly increase allocation to income-focused ETF (QQQI).
